catalogue.display_name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next · HaloForge Labs lower-memory quant (GSQ-RCO)
catalogue.about: A lower-memory version of Alibaba Qwen’s Qwen3.8 Flash Next, using Huihui’s abliterated base, which reduces refusal behavior. HaloForge Labs prepared this quantisation to reduce memory use. GSQ-RCO by ISTA DAS Lab. Expert weights from ISTA DAS Lab’s GSQ-RCO file; for that file, ISTA reports results matching the original model on AIME25 and within 0.57 points on LiveCodeBench v6.
